metadata.title: Monochromatic Cyan Portrait with Condensed Sans-Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, monochromatic cyan portrait featuring an extreme close-up of a face framed by flowing hair, paired with tall, condensed sans-serif typography in a contrasting warm peach tone.
excludeWhen: serif or script typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a female face, centered and filling the frame, treated with a heavy cyan/blue monochromatic filter. The lighting is high-key, blowing out details in the skin while maintaining sharp focus on the eyes. The hair is windswept and flows outward, creating a textured frame. Typography is placed in the corners, featuring a highly condensed, tall sans-serif font in a pale peach color with a subtle drop shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic blue palette vs. warm peach typography
Extreme close-up scale vs. corner-aligned text
High-key lighting vs. sharp eye detail
Flowing hair texture vs. rigid geometric letterforms
coreInvariants: Monochromatic cyan/blue color grading across the entire image
High-key lighting that minimizes mid-tone skin detail
Tall, condensed sans-serif typography with a drop shadow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face is centered and occupies approximately 80% of the vertical frame, cropped at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, which are the only high-contrast dark elements in the monochromatic field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the centered eyes, moves outward along the flowing hair, and then to the typographic elements in the top-left and bottom-right corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the face and hair fill the majority of the square format.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Navy (Shadows in eyes and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, medium saturation cyan dominates; typography provides a low-saturation warm contrast.
paletteRestrictions: No greens or reds in the image area

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in two different positions to create diagonal balance.
graphicDevices: Drop shadow for legibility against textured hair

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and flat terminals.
Similar weight but requires horizontal scaling to match the condensed look.
Captures the geometric, modern feel of the 2000s era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, extreme close-up portrait of a face with flowing hair, entirely color-graded in a monochromatic cyan/blue palette. Ensure the eyes are sharp and dark while the skin is bright and low-detail.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in the top-left and bottom-right corners using an extra-condensed sans-serif font in pale peach with a subtle black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the image entirely monochromatic blue/cyan?
Is the font extra-condensed and tall?
Is the text color a warm peach tone?
Is the portrait an extreme close-up?

postGenerationChecks: Verify font aspect ratio is tall and narrow
Ensure drop shadow on text is subtle
Confirm high-key lighting doesn't lose eye detail
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochromatic Cyan Portrait + High-Key Lighting + Condensed Peach Sans-Serif
